page.content:
Armando is a patron of Flaming Moe's. He made friends with Barney Gumble. Homer meets him along with Raffi in the bathroom after sneaking into Flaming Moe's and they are introduced to each other.

Who is Armando?

Armando is a patron of Flaming Moe's. He made friends with Barney Gumble. Homer meets him along with Raffi in the bathroom after sneaking into Flaming Moe's and they are introduced to each other.
